raw: {"diagnosis": "LVH", "stemi": "no", "rationale": "Very deep S waves in V1-V3 (about 35 mm or more) with tall R in aVL and ST-T strain changes in I and aVL meet voltage criteria for LVH, and the ST elevation in V1-V3 is discordant to the deep S waves, which is expected with LVH, so it does not meet STEMI criteria."}
